items.summary: NIKE (NYSE:NKE) introduced new Tuned Air, Nike Mind, and Nike Free product platforms across footwear and apparel in a broad refresh. items.title: A $300,000 Portfolio in Kimco Realty, Eversource and Nike Pays $13,643 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $300,000 portfolio split evenly across Kimco Realty, Eversource Energy and Nike pays about $1,140 a month in dividends at today’s prices. Eversource’s dividend is the best covered of the three, at 63% of normalized EPS in fiscal 2025, and Kimco paid out 80% of its AFFO that year.
